A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Lens research work. All 18 pages in each version, including equations, tables, figures, and Appendix A.1–A.3, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original traffic-classification and generation experiments, tokenizer comparisons, ablations, and appendix results.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix A, including benchmark comparisons and ablations.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical tokenization, T5 encoder-decoder architecture, four embeddings, MSP/POP/HTP objectives, and fine-tuning procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six datasets, 15 understanding tasks, and five header-generation tasks. Cross Platform remains excluded from pre-training to evaluate generalization.

E2.justification: Tables 4–5 retain FS-Net, BiLSTM_Att, Datanet, DeepPacket, TSCRNN, YaTC, and ET-BERT. NetShare remains the generation comparator in Tables 6, 10, and 11.

E3.justification: Dataset counts, packet selection, the 4:1 fine-tuning split, model configuration, training budgets, and evaluation metrics remain identical in Section 4.1 and Appendix A.1.

E4.justification: The tokenizer comparison, component-removal and pre-training ablations, loss-weight sweep, and generation-distribution analyses are unchanged in Table 2, Section 4.3, and Appendix A.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point-estimate reporting without reported repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 2 and 4–11 retain identical result entries, and Figures 3–9 show identical distributions. For example, Table 5 retains Lens packet-level average accuracy of 0.9784.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and loss equations (1)–(4), including Appendix A.1's diversity-ratio definition, are unchanged. Some equations move across page boundaries.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about joint traffic understanding and generation, specialized pre-training objectives, benchmark performance, and labeled-data efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of generalization, pre-training component effects, and generated-traffic quality remain identical. No limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: Section 4.1.3 retains the same hyperparameters, AdamW optimizer, and single-GPU setup with 48GB memory. Data-processing descriptions and access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Table 1, and all 45 references are unchanged. The positioning against earlier methods, including the stated exclusion of NetGPT from experiments, remains identical.

P1.justification: v4 adds Gang Zhou and his affiliation/email to the author block and updates version/date headers. The research prose and section sequence are unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded author block causes text and table reflow. Table 6 moves from page 9 to 10, and Table 8 from page 10 to 11; figure and table content remains unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 adds an author and reflows the document while preserving all scientific content, results, and appendix evidence. These limited presentation edits leave the paper's clarity, rigor, and reproducibility materially unchanged.
